title: RWANG Entity Registry Entry
description: Normative schema for one entry under docs/registry/entities/** (CR-2026-08-20-01 A2 §2.3). The Registry is the identity source of truth; the graph is a projection of it. Entries are authored as YAML and validated against this schema after parsing.

entity_id.description: Stable ID in a registered namespace

canonical_path.description: Path of the entity's source artifact, relative to project root

label.description: Human display name (e.g. queue_management). Data, never identity: labels may change freely; IDs may not. In name-only filename mode the filename is derived from this label.

parent_domain_id.description: Required for features. Domain membership is declared here, never inferred from filename letters or sequence positions.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'draft' permits incomplete required views during staged rollout without disabling gates project-wide.

doc_version.description: Semver of the backing document, for document-backed entities. A content change without a bump fails RWG-108.

nested.description: Nested registrations owned by this entity (CR §2.3.2) — typically requirements/diagrams/test specs under a feature

aliases.description: Equivalent stable IDs in other namespaces (CR §2.3.4). Two unlinked namespaces for the same entity fail reconciliation; declare an alias here or connect distinct entities with a 'refines' edge.

provenance.description: Audit metadata (CR §2.5). Never participates in semantic_hash or exact-set reconciliation.

source_ref.description: Commit SHA, or content-digest of the discovery set in no-VCS mode

approval_ref.description: CR/approval reference. REQUIRED (non-null) when actor_type is 'agent' — otherwise the mutation fails RWG-107.
